stack: Ruby 4.0.7 + Rails 8.1.4 + ERB + jQuery/jQuery-UI + propshaft + sqlite — image dérivée de mirror.gcr.io/library/redmine:latest

boot.clone: git clone https://github.com/redmine/redmine redmine40 && cd redmine40 && git checkout 10d61f8aea263a12ebc028dba5f0e8a373938212
boot.image: docker build -t redmine40-img -f tools/Dockerfile <clone_patché> — mécanisme : l'image officielle redmine:latest embarque la release 7.0.2 SANS toolchain de build (bundle install de HEAD échoue sur json 3.0.2 etc.) ; tools/Dockerfile ajoute build-essential + libsqlite3-dev + libyaml-dev, écrit Gemfile.local `gem "puma"`, bundle install (BUNDLE_WITHOUT=development:test), puis COPY de l'arbre complet patché + assets:precompile (propshaft). Le patch s'applique donc aux vraies sources avant la compilation des assets.
boot.db: sqlite persistante dans le conteneur (REDMINE_DB_DATABASE=db/redmine.sqlite3), schéma + admin migrés par l'entrypoint amont au 1er boot
boot.seed: docker cp tools/seed.rb redmine40:/tmp/seed.rb && docker exec -e SECRET_KEY_BASE=redmine40cycle40fixedsecretkeybase0123456789abcdef redmine40 bundle exec rails runner /tmp/seed.rb — idempotent : projet office-website, 15 issues (dont #6), wiki accueil+page, 2 messages board, users admin/jsmith/jdoe/pleblanc (membres), query 'Open bugs' id=8, pleblanc NON watcher de #6 (état autocomplete)
boot.login: node tools/login.mjs http://localhost:5801 — admin/redmine40-pw, #username/#password, écrit tools/auth.json (storageState)
boot.gotcha: docker exec BYPASSE l'entrypoint → toujours passer -e SECRET_KEY_BASE=redmine40cycle40fixedsecretkeybase0123456789abcdef aux rails runner/rake

auth: tools/auth.json — storageState Playwright (cookie _redmine_session ; admin/redmine40-pw, régénérable via login.mjs)
urls: tools/urls-public.txt (13 routes : / /login /account/register /projects … gantt/calendar/search publics) + tools/urls-auth.txt (25 routes : my/page, issues list+detail+new, query Open bugs, gantt, calendar, wiki, news, boards, documents, versions, time_entries, files, search, admin, admin/projects, users, roles)
states: 9 états dynamiques (states.json) : public = login-failed + mobile-nav-390 ; auth = issues-options, issues-add-filter, context-menu, account-dropdown, issue-edit, watchers-autocomplete, sidebar-collapsed + mobile-nav-390. login-failed exclu du run auth (#username absent une fois connecté). Open-actions déterministes + stateProof (leçon 32). URLs de requêtes pinnées ?set_filter=1 (retrieve_query lit la session).
